text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Oh? There you are. You sounded in quite a 
rush on the phone, what happened, 
Tarumae-san?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"O proud survivor of the local idols. To 
fulfill thine destiny, ascend the northern 
tower from the harbor and claim the 
sword."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Gold Ship-san has been saying nothing but 
this for a while now!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"O proud survivor of the local idols. To 
fulfill thine destiny, ascend the northern 
tower from the harbor and claim the 
sword."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...I understand. Leave it to me, 
Tarumae-san."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"O proud survivor of the local idols. To 
fulfill thine destiny, ascend the northern 
tower from the harbor and claim the 
sword."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ho ho ho. O brave local idol. May the 
light be with thee...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
It worked...! As expected, you really know 
your stuff!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Heh... The trick is not to listen too 
closely to the "words."
